notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Sage of Hours.
description:
Activate Sage of Hours by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
When Sage of Hours enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing Deadeye Navigator and Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
